candidate_relations.scope_detail: eosinophilic gastroenteritis is a different enteropathy

candidate_relations.reason: Multifocal noncaseating GI microgranulomas, negative AFB/fungal stains, hepatosplenomegaly, and elevated ACE match sarcoidosis.
Duodenitis was an endoscopic observation; granulomas throughout the gut define sarcoidosis rather than isolated duodenitis.
Crohn disease is a related granulomatous enteropathy but conflicts with extra-intestinal sarcoid features (ACE elevation, hepatosplenomegaly, negative chest CT still labeled sarcoidosis).
